# Purpose

This document explains an R script that analyzes synthetic student scores by calculating the mean, maximum, and minimum values.

## Inputs

The script uses five synthetic student scores: 75, 82, 90, 68, and 85. No real student data is used.

## Outputs

The script displays the student scores and calculates the mean, maximum, and minimum scores.

## R Code Example

```{r}
scores <- c(75, 82, 90, 68, 85)
print(scores)
mean(scores)
max(scores)
min(scores)
```
